title: Edition route: PHerc.1667 column lattice on the org's 2.4 um ink renders (numbers only)
status: HARD STOP (text rule): row periodicity in the w031 intercolumn candidate ic_33. The authors decide.

cols_1_3.method: Unrolled distance from the outer end of the roll to the outer end of each target segment, D_out = sum of flattened lengths (area / z-height from each official 2.399 um mesh meta.json) of all segments further out. Wrap order: higher wNNN = further out (circumference grows with the index); w013/w018/w023 are 5-wrap blocks. Column 1 is at the outer end (text starts outside; cols 1-3 = surviving traces).
cols_1_3.rule: Stop that segment if D_out < 293 mm (= 1.3 x 3 columns x 75 mm, the larger period estimate, 30% margin).
cols_1_3.result_before_any_render: All four targets clear the rule (min D_out 597 mm). Caveat: the inner hypothesis (numbering from the core) would put w018's inner end ~276 mm from the core; column 1 at the outer end is the papyrological convention and the authors' reading.
